selection: Frozen test-clean divided into eight equal-count duration bins. In each bin take the eight smallest SHA-256 of l3-diagnostic-20261121|UID. No predictions used in selection.
reference_nll: Batch-one frozen FP32 checkpoint. Sum probability over standard RNNT paths for the supplied reference; no beam search. Uniform intervention averages contiguous floor(j*N/K) bins at the native output length K.
